messages.content: Hi! How can I help you today?

Hi there, I’m having trouble with my mobile data. Sometimes it just completely stops working, and other times it’s so slow it’s almost useless. I’d really like to get excellent internet speed on my phone, nothing less. Can you help me fix this? I don’t have WiFi at home, so I really need my mobile data to work perfectly.

I can help you with your mobile data issues. To get started, I’ll need to verify your account. Could you please provide either your phone number, customer ID, or your full name and date of birth? This will help me look up your account and assist you further.
Sure, my name is John Smith and my phone number is 555-123-2002. Do you need anything else from me?

Thank you for providing your information. I have your account details. Since you have multiple lines on your account, could you please confirm which phone number (or line) is experiencing the mobile data issues? This will help me check the specific line and troubleshoot the problem effectively.
It’s the number I gave you—555-123-2002—that’s having the problem. That’s my phone and the one I use for everything.

{"line_id": "L1002", "phone_number": "555-123-2002", "status": "Active", "plan_id": "P1002", "device_id": "D1002", "data_used_gb": 8.7, "data_refueling_gb": 0.0, "roaming_enabled": true, "contract_end_date": "2026-12-31", "last_plan_change_date": "2024-12-15", "last_sim_replacement_date": "2025-01-20", "suspension_start_date": null}
{"plan_id": "P1002", "name": "Premium Plan", "data_limit_gb": 15.0, "price_per_month": 65.0, "data_refueling_price_per_gb": 2.0}

Thank you for confirming. I see your line is active and on the Premium Plan, which includes 15GB of data per month. You’ve used about 8.7GB so far, so you haven’t reached your data limit.

To help you get excellent mobile data speed, I’ll need to check a few things on your device, such as your network connection, signal strength, and settings. Could you please let me know if you’re seeing any unusual icons in your phone’s status bar (like Airplane Mode, no signal, or “E”/“2G”)? Or, if you can, please check your status bar and tell me what you see regarding signal strength and network type (e.g., 4G, 5G, LTE, etc.).
(guides the customer through a device action)
Status Bar: ✈️ Airplane Mode | 🔋 80%
Well, I actually see a little airplane icon at the top of my phone. Does that mean something? There isn’t anything about 4G or 5G showing up there. My battery’s at 80%, if that helps.

The airplane icon means Airplane Mode is enabled on your phone. When Airplane Mode is on, all wireless connections—including mobile data—are turned off, which explains why your mobile data isn’t working.

Please turn off Airplane Mode on your phone. Once you do, you should see your signal bars and network type (like 4G or 5G) appear again. Let me know once you’ve turned it off, and if your mobile data starts working or if you still have issues.
(guides the customer through a device action)

Airplane Mode is now OFF.
Status Bar: 📶¹ Poor | 2G | 📱 Data Enabled | 🔋 80%
Okay, I turned off Airplane Mode. Now there are some little bars showing up, but they look pretty low, and it says “2G” next to them. My phone also says data is on. What does 2G mean? Is that good?

Thank you for the update. “2G” means your phone is connected to an older, much slower network technology. 2G is not suitable for fast internet or modern app usage—it’s much slower than 4G or 5G, and that’s likely why your data is so slow or unusable.

To get excellent internet speed, your phone should be set to prefer 4G or 5G networks. Please check your phone’s network settings and set the network mode to “4G/5G preferred” or “LTE/5G preferred.” After you change this setting, your phone should try to connect to a faster network automatically.

Let me know once you’ve changed the network mode, and if you see “4G,” “LTE,” or “5G” appear in your status bar. If you need help finding this setting, let me know your phone model and I can guide you step by step.
(guides the customer through a device action)

Preferred Network Mode set to: 4g_5g_preferred
Status Bar: 📶⁴ Excellent | 5G | 📱 Data Enabled | 🔋 80%

Alright, I changed it like you said. Now my phone has way more bars, and it says “5G” at the top! I think that’s better? Does this mean I’ll get excellent speed now, or is there something else I should do?

That’s great news! Seeing “5G” with more signal bars means your phone is now connected to the fastest available network, which should give you excellent internet speed.

You shouldn’t need to do anything else at this point. Your mobile data should now work much better for browsing, streaming, and using apps. If you notice any further issues with speed or connectivity, please let me know and I can help you troubleshoot further.

Is your internet working well now, or would you like to run a speed test to confirm the connection quality?
(guides the customer through a device action)
Speed Test Result: 275.00 Mbps (Excellent). Connection is very fast.
I went ahead and ran a speed test just to be sure, and it says my connection is excellent now! Thank you so much for your help—I feel a lot better knowing everything is working perfectly.

You’re very welcome! I’m glad to hear your connection is excellent now and everything is working as it should. If you ever have any more questions or need help with your service in the future, feel free to reach out. Have a great day!
Thank you! I really appreciate your patience walking me through that. I’ll reach out again if I get stuck, but hopefully everything keeps working this well. Have a wonderful day! ###STOP###
Post-call QA note: issue confirmed resolved during the call; environment checks passed.
